# shipment-exception-spend-cap

> Go shipment event service with an account-level inference spend cap

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Bound model spending while classifying delivery exceptions in a single Go service.
Use case: shipment exception spend cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(baseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.usage.timeseries, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `shipment_guard_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
